definitions.explanation: The count of how many times something occurs or is done.

examples.japanese: ⟦{利用|りよう}→利用：01752_riyou⟧{回数|かいすう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{制限|せいげん}→制限：03375_seigen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is a limit on the number of uses.

examples.japanese: ⟦{練習|れんしゅう}→練習：05323_renshuu⟧{回数|かいすう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{増|ふ}やしたら→増やす：02410_fuyasu⟧、⟦{上手|じょうず}→上手：00707_jouzu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: I got better after increasing the number of practice sessions.

examples.japanese: {回数|かいすう}⟦{券|けん}→券：02150_ken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{割引|わりびき}→割引：01526_waribiki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Buying a book of tickets gives you a discount.
examples.notes: {回数|かいすう}⟦{券|けん}→券：02150_ken⟧ = multi-ride ticket, book of tickets

notes:
{回数|かいすう} counts the number of times something happens or is performed.

Common expressions:
- {回数|かいすう}⟦{券|けん}→券：02150_ken⟧ (book of tickets, multi-ride pass)
- ⟦{利用|りよう}→利用：01752_riyou⟧{回数|かいすう} (number of uses)
- ⟦{練習|れんしゅう}→練習：05323_renshuu⟧{回数|かいすう} (number of practice sessions)
- {回数|かいすう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{重|かさ}ねる→重ねる：02039_kasaneru⟧ (to accumulate instances)

Related terms:
- ⟦{頻度|ひんど}→頻度：14619_hindo⟧ (frequency - focuses on rate/how often)
- ⟦{度数|どすう}→度数：19737_dosuu⟧ (frequency, number of degrees)
